description: The structured result of a completed call. outcome is one of ok (someone answered and the conversation took place, whatever came of it: read summary), needs_human (the other side will only deal with the user, or the matter needs the user's decision), needs_website (they said it must be done online), voicemail (an answering machine picked up and the agent left a message), voicemail_no_message (an answering machine or a no-answer announcement picked up and no message was left), fax, no_answer, busy, failed or unknown; next_recommended_action is none, retry_call, use_website, ask_user (the user must decide or supply something) or manual_followup; answered_by is "machine" or "fax" when the agent heard one, else null; voicemail_message is "left" (the message states who called and why), "unable" (no recording was offered, or only a goodbye was said) or "declined_by_agent" (the agent's instructions said not to leave one) when a machine picked up, else null. When someone spoke on the call, summary says what was said and how it ended, written from a machine transcript in the language of the call's instructions, and result_data has nextStep (what to do now), missingDetails (what the other side needed that the agent could not give) and unclearPhrases (what could not be made out, quoted as heard). Right after a call ends this tool waits up to 45 seconds for that result.
name: callout_get_call_result
title: Get call result
